title: Perfect Fall Soup ("The Good Soup")
ingredients: 3 to 4 Russet potatoes (depending on size), cubed
1 diced small white onion (or yellow onion for a sweeter flavor)
2-3 minced cloves of garlic (or 1 tablespoon of jarlic)
2 tablespoons buffalo or your favorite hot sauce
Chili powder, basil, parsley, and Italian seasoning, to taste
instructions: Brown ground sausage in your soup pot on medium-high heat.
Remove sausage from pot and set aside. Keep the grease and fat in the pot for the saute.
Melt your butter in the pot.
Add diced celery, carrots, and onion.
Saute on medium-high heat for 3-5 minutes or until tender and fragrant.
Add garlic and saute for another minute.
Season with pepper (and salt if using unsalted butter).
Cook for another 3-4 minutes or until the flour mixture starts to brown (it'll start to smell a little like biscuits).
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the cubed potatoes, heavy cream, soy sauce, and buffalo sauce, and stir.
Salt and pepper to taste, and season with chili powder, basil, parsley, and Italian seasoning.
Bring back to a boil, then simmer for 30-40 minutes on low heat (or until potatoes are tender), stirring occasionally.
When about 10 minutes remain, add the ground sausage back to the pot to finish it up.
Serve with a nice loaf of sourdough.
notes: Recipe from Cass & Quinn (Facebook), called 'the good soup' in their house, brought back for autumn. Full recipe was in the first/pinned comment on the reel, posted by the author.
